heading: MIW II Directional Power Protection System - Legacy

text: The MIW II, a member of the M II Family of Relays, is a digital device that provides directional power and loss of field protection for generators. Operation of the MIW II is based on the calculated direction of 3 phase power flow. The MIW II can be ordered with either one of the following two option packages:
